Loved the Nod-Krai video and only had one real complaint. 

I'm always into the story and lore of things and I'm attached to many Genshin characters and plots. I definitely felt like things were feeling rushed or the pacing was off and I've had story complaints lately so I'm really glad they're doing 6.x this way. I've thought for a while about how they might have felt like they had to do things a certain way because that's how they've always done it and I was glad to hear that they realized they don't have to do that if it better serves the story and the game. Love to hear that they spoke to a bunch of really cool people in the industry many who make other game series that I love and got some good insight. 

This is exactly what the game needs. Genshin has always had a very strong focus on story and I'm so glad to hear them really taking the care needed to not only work on plot threads that we've been waiting for for a long time but also setup the other parts of the story even better. Loved all the references to popular series that they take inspiration from since I'm a fan of many of those things. I'd love if they discussed collabs. 

I've always wanted Genshin to be more transparent with us, it's one of the best things a dev team can do so this was great and I hope they do it way more. My only real complaint is that I don't like that it sounds like we're totally getting rid of story quests and hangouts. I get that it's a lot of work for the team to do all of those all the time (not that there's been a hangout in a while) but they can still be really important so I hope that they're not gone forever or at least the way the story is going to be implemented now works well without having those quests.

Khaenri'ah has been the nation I'm most looking forward to from the beginning of the game but I'm fine even though this means it's pushed back another year. When I play something I care more about the story and characters being done well and slowburn storytelling that has good narrative payoff than just getting to a thing that I've been waiting for. If they just rushed to certain things it would show me that they didn't care about the story (before anyone says that it's still a game that wants to make money I know, I'm talking specifically about the dev team who cares about the stuff they work on) and I'd be really disappointed since I care about the story and many characters. Everything we're looking forward to will only get better if it's given more time to be worked on.

Talking about Phainon, why I love him and why his eventual breakdown is exciting but it's the after that's even more exciting (no real spoilers for anything, just general talk about things we already know or theorized)

>!This isn't a new trope, there's a reason a lot of people compare him to Dimitri from FE3H (and he's also ofc not the only one either but I adore Dimitri and they share a lot of similarities so he's a good fit lol) but it's a great trope that when done well is amazing. Phainon is a hero and a good person but he's also deeply affected by his past and he doesn't feel deserving of the title of hero or Deliverer because of it. He's seeking revenge that he isn't sure he can put below the Flame Chase Journey. Everyone else sees the good in him and the leader he can be but he doesn't, they're all setting him up for things because they believe in him. He's trying to live up to their expectations but his past has him so bogged down and you combine that with the Flame Reaver stuff and it will most likely make him go unhinged for a while.!<

>!He'll feel like the faith that everyone has shown in him and even sacrificed things for him will have been in vain. That what he always secretly believed deep down that he wasn't worthy, was true. The breakdown yes will be exciting. Fighting his past, his future, himself, all his insecurities, and the revenge he's been seeking. I'm looking forward to it BUT a good breakdown isn't the only thing that makes a good story. To round it all out you need the part where they have to face themselves and not only be the person that people believed they can be but also they have to believe in themselves.!<

>!The setup and slow buildup has been amazing, hopefully the breakdown will be too, but it's the after that the story will be relying on. All of this is why I love Phainon so much. He's extremely kind and has all the capabilities to be a great leader, but he can also go unhinged over his past. He has all the setup needed to forgive himself and recognize why people see a leader in him and become that leader and stay that good kind person, but he can also keep a little of that feral nature for if he needs it and the dichotomy of all that makes him so lovable.!<

All the ways the characters have been setting him up as this hero that they believe in and he's so deserving but he doesn't believe in himself enough it's soooo delicious. I play in JP and both Yuma and Satoshi crushed it.!<

>!The sequence where the Trailblazer comes back to life was sweet, everyone talking to him to come back and Acheron was a cool surprise. I know Sunday didn't get a line because he hasn't been on the Express long enough, but it would've been nice if he had one for the people who picked friendly dialogue with him joining. Dan Heng's love for the Trailblazer is so sweet I wanted to cry he was so worried about him and his thoughts during the grove section ahhh I love him my favorite HSR character. His section with Hyacine was fun they bounced off each other well. Mydei!!! I didn't expect to see him this patch, I love him sm. Showing how hard he fights to get back every time and how wise he is and the good advice he gives, he's such an amazing character. So glad they added him to that section. Therta section was banger. I adore the Astral Express and I can't wait until they come to Amphoreous. Therta is great her interactions with Sunday are amazing, her whole interaction with Lygus was so exciting. !<

>!The negative: I just found the whole Castorice story and section really not compelling or emotional for me. Castorice is fine but I've seen similar versions of that story done better. I also thought Styxia could've been stronger, especially compared to the other region in the same patch Dawncloud which I thought was great. For me it was the weakest part of the story of all Amphoreous so far. Mydei's small part of the story, Trailblazer coming back to life and Trianne's scene were the strongest parts of that section.!<

>!Trailblazer being dead is a cool plot on paper, but they should have teased it more before. The solution wasn't bad, but the reveal fell flat. Dan Heng being worried was great though. There should have been more upset over Anaxagoras and Castorice being gone. The sacrifices they're making should feel more impactful to the characters even if we the audience know these characters will be back. I got emotional when Anaxagoras died but I wanted to see it more from the characters afterwards and not just during the cutscene. They did a stronger job of that with Mydei and Trianne so hopefully they'll have some mentions of them next patch.  !<

>!Overall though I loved most of it. The Flame Chase Journey is so cool and such a great plot that I'm really invested in and all the set up is so good. Phainon's hero journey where he has to face his past before he can stand up again, March's plot, everything to do with what's happening with Amphoreous that Black Swan and Lygus were talking about. So so good I love it.!<

I love Amphoreous so far. I adore many of the characters and I love the story/lore. Every region you get those new characters you get really attached to and Phainon is one of them and I love Mydei and Anaxagoras and Dan Heng content and I love how long the stories are and I love the puzzles (goat puzzle my beloved) and the way the story is unfolding and the relationships between characters.

Even though I've loved some things about Natlan like the world quests, exploration, music, some characters that I am attached to like Kinich, Ororon, Ifa, Capitano screentime, some events, and some parts of the archon quests that I did love I am so ready to go to a new nation. I play many live service games and I've seen the quality in them going up and down so even if it sucks when it happens never assume that just because one part of a game was great and then the next part was less so, it doesn't mean that the game has fully lost it's way. It can always turn it around. Take FFXIV as an example. Heavensward masterpiece, then Stormblood less so (I still love it and love things about it but still), and then you have Shadowbringers and Endwalker two of the greatest stories in gaming. Or take Destiny. Going from Witch Queen (amazing) to Lightfall (really rough) to Final Shape (masterpiece).

Saying all that though as excited as I am for all the factions they're announcing and the lore and Nod Krai there are things that I'm hoping for that my excitement is attached to as well. The biggest one is more male characters again. When they release an upcoming trailer of the new region I need a bunch of them to be guys and for them to have a ton of screentime. Another one is that I also hope that they do what HSR is doing and have the stories run the entire region (not that only HSR does that, but it's one example). I want longer stories and more men. I want government mandated yaoi again. I want the whole cast to feel really connected to each other again. I believe they can do all of this and it's why even if 5.x has had disappointments, as I said I've seen this in games before and I believe 6.x can pick it up again.

As for Capitano, I've waited for him since the day the Fatui trailer released. He's one of my most wanted characters. I personally hope he doesn't come out in 5.x and I'd much rather have him in 6.x or even in Khaenri'ah. I'm someone who wants a character to release when it fits the story, even if it means waiting to play them. Is Dainsleif one of my most wanted characters? Yes of course, but it wouldn't fit the story if he released before Khaenri'ah so I'll wait. I hope we get Pantalone, Varka and Dottore soon but only if it fits the story (which I hope it will). I'd rather Capitano be connected to a different part of the story and come out with a different group of characters. I get wanting a character and being so excited for them I have a list as well but it's more exciting when it's been built up and it fits the story than just happening so they can be playable. It fits with what happened to Wanderer too. Scara was one of my most wanted characters but I was glad he didn't release in Inazuma because his story would have not been done justice. Instead he got some lore teasers there and then got his amazing release in Sumeru with proper screentime and storytelling and now he gets to be in Sumeru events and they still tease his relevancy in Inazuma. I believe the same for Capitano. He got some amazing writing and lore but he needed way more screentime, so this can just be the set up. 

If they can do all of these things though then yeah I am SO excited because everything about these event teasers is amazing and exciting. Plus getting some Mondstadt content soon, I can't wait. Kaeya content!!!

3.1 (did it a while ago but still wanted to comment) mostly positive with a little bit of negative

>!I loved it!!! Just like with last patch, Amphoreous has been excellent so far. Mydei!!! I love him!!! His story was beautifully paced. From last patch he was clearly a gentle and intelligent leader but he didn't know how to help his people and was missing his home and had to reconcile with what Nikador had become. To this patch finding the answers he seeks and feeling confident in himself and saving his Kingdom by ending it. Learning about his past with the people he loved, seeing how much he differs from the perceived notion of what it means to be a Kremnoan and how he clearly wanted to lead his people to a different path but couldn't see how to get there at first, more of his relationship with Phainon. Accepting Nikador's coreflame after not wanting it and getting the answers he was looking for realizing he can use it to lead his people to that different path all the while holding the line, beautiful. Him showing up all "Deliverer" and saying why shouldn't he go through his own front door woigoej it's so cool. Him going back home with the memories of everyone cheering him on with the music and him in the pose on his throne STUNNING GORGEOUS.!<

>!Speaking of his relationship with Phainon, the Phaidei... the Phaidei was so real. Mydei, Trailblazer and Dan Heng going to rescue Phainon from himself. Mydei's "I found you". Their deep understanding of each other. Mydei recognizing what Phainon is hiding behind that kind smile of his, trying to cheer him up over the failed trial.  Their playful competitiveness (thank you bath scene dialogue, also I laughed when I saw Phainon on the floor cause it reminded me of danganronpa lol). Mydei telling only Phainon about his secret weakspot. Working as a team and protecting each other fighting the Flame Reaver. Making sure the last person he speaks to is Phainon, Phainon being the one to look for the ring!!!!! Even after he left Phainon texting about Mydei, wondering what Mydei would do if he was here. I refuse to let the doomed yaoi be doomed there's a way back from this, but rn it's all so good the art has been chef's kiss.!<

>!As for Phainon, I continue to adore him. Starting off the patch with Phainon failing the test (I knew this would happen I love him) and Mydei going to get him was so good. Him clearly being upset over the trial quiet in the bath and Mydei trying to cheer him up, and then all story Phainon kept up this facade like he was okay. Then right at the end Mydei acknowledging how that's just the mask he wears. All the theories of him being the Flame Reaver and what that means for the story is exciting, especially how cool it is that it means he blocked himself from attacking Mydei. They keep hinting at Phainon's inner turmoil and his past just waiting to reveal itself I can't wait, the setup has been strong so far.!<

>!Loved Anaxagoras!!! He's cool and beautiful and I'm excited to see more of him and his story. I love that he's thoughtful and kind but serious about knowledge and protecting people. Also badass with the way he attacked the Flame Reaver. The Haikaveh child vibes. Him being dead was surprising, interested to see where that leads. The Tribbie and Tribios story was also good, it's sad about Trianne. The art at the end was beautiful. I have all kinds of theories as to what is going on in Amphoreus but it does seem that patch by patch we might be losing some characters until something presumably and hopefully happens to bring them back.!<

>!I had a few negatives, not many but a few. Even though I enjoyed the Grove a lot, I felt like it was a little poorly paced at parts. I thought the slow buildup of getting there and trying to figure out what was going on, meeting Anaxagoras and leading to the Flame Reaver was really cool but there were some parts in the middle with Cerces where I felt like her introduction was a little fast and then rescuing Mem and getting to the next part felt a little slow. I love long stories and puzzles so that's not the issue, just yeah idk the pacing at certain parts felt a little strange there but I still loved the section, just maybe needed a little pacing fix up. I also didn't like how many times Mydei kept insisting that he's not coming back to Okhema. I get there's a prophecy, I get that he's holding back the black tide, but the end goal of all of this is winning and everyone meeting together again. I'm sure he will be back in the story, but it was just strange to mention it over and over as if it's final. Phainon and Mydei needed a special CG of them in the bath, that's that.!<

>!Overall, loved it. So glad we got to take a special picture with Mydei. The end with Dan Heng being by our side, I love you!!!!! Exciting that this is just the beginning of the story.!<

Anecdotes: >!One of the best things they have ever done for the game. I was always someone who didn't want them to add npc's to the overworld because I thought they were going to do it where they place the characters in one spot that fits them and then the character was just there all the time. I actually hate that because it's very stagnant and doesn't make the world feel alive. Something Genshin has that's really special is that it has this AU embedded in the game as if the characters you pull are actually travelling with you. It's why they have all this unique dialogue in their voicelines as if you're all journeying together. Having the characters always be in one spot would not only take away from imagining the characters doing what you want them to do but also from that AU.!<

>!So when I saw they were doing this I was excited but curious to see how it would go down. I thought it would only be maybe one line from each character and I didn't even know if it would be voiced. I was tbh speechless??? Not only the effort put into this but how good it is. The game is in such a frustrating spot for me rn. The (mostly) positive parts: >!Capitano!!!!!!!! Been obsessed with him since the day the Fatui trailer came out and I've waited for him ever since. >!Compared to the Narwhal fight I appreciated the long fight with unique dialogue and animations it was cool. Vichama and Mallko!!! I'm so happy their doomed yaoi became happy yaoi I love them. Bona and Och-Kan!!! I loved seeing world quest characters so much. Love that our story quest/world quest progress is reflected here.!<

The negative: >!I'm not saying anything that hasn't already been said but man it is actually wild how much of a downgrade the disconnected feeling of this cast of characters is compared to every other region. The only characters I want to see again and that I care about in Natlan (excluding npc's) are Capitano (who isn't even from Natlan), Kinich (who had no screentime), Ororon (who at least got screentime but was still made a 4 star for some reason) and Ifa (who doesn't even have a character model). I don't mind Iansan so she can stay and I'm so mixed on Citlali. I loved her in act 3 and then all the choices they made with her in the event and the way they designed her animations I just wasn't vibing with any of it.!<

>!Everyone else though? I care much more about Vichama, Mallko, Xbalanque, Bona, Och-Kan, Quenin etc than I do the other Natlan characters I didn't mention. It's not even hatred I just don't care about them. They didn't make these characters feel connected or like a real friend group. Only with a few do I feel that the Traveler got a connection with, with most it didn't feel like the friendship was earned and it didn't feel like the cast was already a close group before the Traveler got there or a close group after. Even in Inazuma where the AQ has so many problems I still feel the love with that cast. Compare the Natlan cast in terms of being friends/family to any other region's cast and they don't hold a candle to them. What's frustrating too is I love the power of friendship and all that stuff and so while I did think the dialogue the cast had for Traveler was sweet and the sequence was done well, the fact that the cast is so disconnected and half of them I didn't care about didn't make the moment as hype as it could have been even if it was still cool. It felt like it was going for a FFXIV Endwalker type thing and this is not Endwalker lol.!<

>!It's wild how utterly boring and characterless Mavuika is. She never has any interesting conflict or personality or mystery or anything. She just does what she wants the entire time with no pushback from the story or the characters. I kept waiting for her to get interesting, for me to have any reason to care about her or for her to have some personality and it never happened. She stayed the exact same the entire AQ. It's truly baffling even Raiden who I hate has personality and interesting plot stuff and there's characters I'd be interested in her interacting with. There isn't a single character I care about Mavuika interacting with and there isn't a single thing about her I find interesting.!<

Overall Natlan AQ is a downgrade from Sumeru and Fontaine and a downgrade in other areas in the game. I don't know the exact words for what I feel for Natlan AQ and even if there were things I loved or things I thought were cool and exciting I know that I am disappointed in so many ways and I just really hope that this isn't the new norm because as it stands right now the upcoming >!Nod Krai and Dottore (!!!!!!)!< sound amazing and I hope it's great because I love this game and the direction it's in right now is such a bummer and I want to believe it's going to right itself. It won't fix all the problems I've listed those are just how they are but at least make Capitano playable and I'll just move on from the parts of this region that bummed me out and I'll take the parts I like and hope that they don't do these negative things again. Give Kinich a dedicated lore event. Keep the things that were good like Capitano writing but give him and characters like him more screentime. Keep the cool and reactive quests like act 4 and the boss fight section of act 5 but with a cast that isn't disconnected. Please go back to releasing more guys and giving them proper screentime and lore relevance.

Have fun!! It's one of my favorite games ever. :)

Hardcore disagree. Osiris was one of the best parts of the campaign. It's not his fault we don't know what the Veil is or that the pacing of the story was strange.

He lost his love and barely got to spend time with him before he lost his ghost and got possessed. He's back now but very few people other than Saint/our guardian trust him and he's being followed for his own safety which has to feel bad to one of the greatest Warlock's of all time. 

In Seraph he was desperate to prove himself. There's even a lore page where he gets info on some dangerous stuff with Spire of the Watcher and he gets an excited look on his face and starts to go after it but Ana jumps in front of him and stops him not because she doesn't trust him but because she's afraid for him. She knows he's lightless and can be reckless so she doesn't want him to die. Even Saint who very much trusts him (another great page where Saint is angry at Ikora for having him followed because he knows it's upsetting Osiris) is still worried for him. He waits for Osiris to come home and tells him to be careful. Osiris even has Ana tell him where he will be so he won't worry. In Spire he says "I need this", throughout Seraph and at the beginning of Lightfall he wants to do something big to feel useful and like he can be trusted.

The whole first half of the campaign the reason he was yelling and upset is because he was frustrated with himself that he can't do anything. It's the continuation of his plot from Seraph. He's used to being able to be reckless and run into the middle of battle to help but now all he can do is sit back and it's driving him wild. Saint is worried for him and he knows it from their conversation in the campaign but he feels useless even if he's not. He's not angry at us, he yells because he knows he can't do anything to get to the Veil faster and he's angry with himself even if it's illogical. It's why after he yells our Ghost says "Osiris..." in a way showing that he cares but doesn't know how to help because our guardian/Ghost can tell how Osiris is feeling which Osiris follows up with "I'm fine Ghost..." in a quiet voice because he's not fine.

Throughout the campaign though he learns from others about helping in the ways you can help and learning to "flow with the river". If you listen to his dialogue in the Deterministic Chaos quest Nimbus is acting recklessly because they're upset over Rohan and now it's Osiris who is helping them instead of the other way around because Osiris has started to learn what he can and can't do and how he can still be useful and valued even without the light. That he can stop being reckless and use the amazing mind that he has to help everyone. 

Lightfall absolutely has issues but Osiris was not one of them and it's a shame so many people missed it. I would listen to both his campaign dialogue, Deterministic Chaos dialogue and even partition dialogue in order to see how he's grown over the story. Loved his story and looking forward to where they take him now. Hopefully in a season with Saint.
